answer: Canyon walnut toll: each agent joins the work pool via one canyon gate, paying a walnut toll, a single-use key-signed receipt. The crossing enters the canyon ledger as a fable, a signed record. Auditors replay each fable; a copied fable or reused walnut burns its 70-credit bond. First crossing 35, the k-th 35+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,531,500 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented walnut rings fail, one per key; honest agents pay 35 once.
